Quarto Pipeline

Pipeline.Rmd

Here we document, create, and run the pipeline all in one file thanks to Quarto and targets.

For the backend, we’ll use this Quarto notebook as the “orchestrator,” meaning that the pipeline runs any time this notebook is executed/rendered. First, let’s get the script files from the inputs directory:

devtools::load_all()

The inputs were provided by stagecoach. The manifest for the stagecoach run is in stagecoach_manifest.yml if you want to check it out.

manifest <- here("stagecoach_manifest.yml")
repo_files <- list.files(
    here(
      "data", 
      "inputs"
    ),
    recursive = TRUE
)
